titleEn: Maximum Enemy Forts That Can Be Captured
title: 最多可以摧毁的敌人城堡数目
summary: 数组中 1 是己方城堡、负一是敌方城堡、零是空地；可从一方城堡沿连续空地移动到另一方城堡并占领沿途，求最多可占领的空地数。
insight: 合法区间的两个非零端点必须符号相反，中间自然全是零。扫描相邻的非零位置，符号不同则用下标差减一更新答案。
pitfalls: 端点必须一个一、一个负一，方向不限
两个端点之间不能出现其他城堡
统计的是中间零的数量

solutions.title: 扫描相邻非零边界
solutions.idea: 只保留上一个非零位置即可。
steps: 若 previous 有效且 forts[previous]!=forts[i]，更新 i-previous-1

code.java: class Solution { public int captureForts(int[] forts){int previous=-1,answer=0;for(int i=0;i<forts.length;i++)if(forts[i]!=0){if(previous>=0&&forts[previous]!=forts[i])answer=Math.max(answer,i-previous-1);previous=i;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun captureForts(forts:IntArray):Int{var previous=-1;var answer=0;for(i in forts.indices)if(forts[i]!=0){if(previous>=0&&forts[previous]!=forts[i])answer=maxOf(answer,i-previous-1);previous=i};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int captureForts(vector<int>& forts){int previous=-1,answer=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)forts.size();++i)if(forts[i]){if(previous>=0&&forts[previous]!=forts[i])answer=max(answer,i-previous-1);previous=i;}return answer;} };
